mods.name: USB Hub Support
mods.author: NachoCasta
mods.summary: Browse USB hub sticks locally alongside PRO DJ LINK.
mods.description:
LINK MODE CHANGE: Select the intended PRO DJ LINK mode before loading hub tracks. Switching On/Off briefly disconnects hub sources and can leave loaded tracks with the source-unavailable triangle and finite cached playback. This issue remains unresolved.

Browse and load hub USB libraries with four local decks when Link is off, or two local decks with external-player communication when on. Hub libraries stay local and are not shared with external CDJs. Real-AZ tests used a software peer over Wi-Fi for master/SYNC, reconnect and a fresh hub-track load; actual-CDJ interoperability and audible phase sync remain unvalidated. Short-press USB STOP to select one stick; hold to eject the hub. Wait for safe-to-remove confirmation. Eight sources implemented, five tested together in the emulator; no eight-source hardware claim. Exact firmware2.00, kernel4.4.194 and core>=1.2.3. AZ-MODS stages files internally. The immutable package retains its original experimental candidate description.
